mission_06: Interaction features combine two or more existing features to capture relationships that individual features cannot express alone. BMI (Body Mass Index) is a classic example: it combines height and weight into a single meaningful metric. Multiplicative interactions (feature_a * feature_b) and ratio features (feature_a / feature_b) are common patterns. In this mission, you will create domain-informed interaction features including BMI, age-exercise interaction, and exercise-to-age ratio. These engineered features often provide more predictive power than raw features.
